items.text: Bears TE Cole Kmet has already been ruled out with a knee injury after being carted off (thumbs up).
items.implication: Immediate TE void in CHI offense.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua left practice early Thursday due to a calf injury and was listed as limited.
items.why: Exited early; calf issue amid already thin WR room post-Adams IR.
items.implication: Questionable/GTD for Week 7 @ LV; monitor Friday.
items.opportunity: If out, Mumpfield/Whittington/Higbee targets rise; heavy TE sets.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice officially didn’t practice for a second straight day due to his hamstring injury (also listed with knee).
items.why: Hamstring (and knee) lingering post-Week 4 tweak; no practice after bye.
items.implication: Likely miss Week 7 vs SEA; elevated role for Worthy/Kelce.
items.opportunity: Xavier Worthy targets/routes spike as de facto WR1.

items.text: Colston Loveland getting the usage over the last few games we all projected entering the season.
items.implication: Rising TE with Kmet now OUT.

items.text: Saquon Barkley is 'in line' to play vs DAL Monday (RB15); efficient in two full games; Dallas top fantasy RB matchup.
items.opportunity: Carries/red-zone vs soft DAL run D.

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed facility access for meetings, lifting, medical/non-football activities. MarShawn Lloyd (49th EPA/rush) and Kaleb Johnson (53rd) poor; OL mess. Long-term Jacobs outlook discussed on ROS Top-150.
items.why: Non-football activity clearance + backups' poor EPA.
items.implication: Positive step for return; handcuffs unreliable ROS.
items.opportunity: Jacobs role reclamation if cleared; fade Lloyd/Johnson.
items.conflict: Berry hates Jacobs this week on workload questions.

items.text: Thorman Week 7 Snaps & Pace (free): Up in pace TB@CAR, GB@DET, LAR@LV (high volume). Slow slogs MIA@NYJ, SF@ATL, IND@MIN. Notes on CLE/DEN/NO/PHI/PIT/TEN.
items.why: Neutral pace/PROE/explosive rates favor high-volume games.
items.implication: Prioritize players in up-pace spots for snaps/opportunities.

items.text: Yards per target to Justin Jefferson: McCarthy 5.7 (vs Mullens 10.8, Cousins 10.5, Darnold 10.0, Wentz 9.9). Scheme/coaches differ, small sample, room to improve but concerning.
items.why: Low YPT with new QB starter McCarthy vs HOU.
items.implication: Efficiency risk for Jefferson fantasy floor/ceiling short-term.
items.opportunity: Monitor routes/targets under McCarthy; possible dissent on start.

items.text: Terrance Ferguson not expected ready off IR soon (recovery 'will take some time'). Notable as biggest Adams beneficiary; Rams' only answer now is 25 Puka Nacua targets per game.
items.why: Adams out 6-10 wks; Ferguson delay leaves Puka as primary.
items.implication: Nuclear target share for Puka if healthy.
items.conflict: Calf exit creates uncertainty on availability.

items.text: 10 Facts: Bo Nix aDOT 5.4 (only 4 completions >=7 air yds past 2 gms) — no viable Broncos WRs. Ashton Jeanty inefficient (<3 YPC 4/5), Washington season-high 33% snaps/near equal rushes. Stroud top-6 fantasy past 3 wks, QB1 upside.
items.implication: Fade Nix/Broncos pass catchers; monitor Jeanty role split.
items.opportunity: Washington handcuff upside if Jeanty limited.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10): Bears good for yardage; Brown back in real role with high target share/routes.
items.why: Matchup + usage rebound (33% tgt share, 97% routes prior).

items.text: Loves DeVonta Smith vs DAL (elite volume), Tucker Kraft @ DET (Lions gift to pass catchers), Jaylen Warren @ NO (big workload friendly matchup).
items.why: Usage + soft defenses (Lions pass, NO run).
items.opportunity: High snap/route/carry shares in plus spots.

items.text: Loves Chuba Hubbard vs TB (consistent workload), Bucky Irving @ CAR (carved-up defenses), Matthew Golden @ DET (leads league deep targets; Lions allow high deep completion %), Jordan Love @ DET (QB3).
items.opportunity: Volume in high-scoring or soft run D spots.

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze vs NE (nasty matchup), Josh Downs @ MIN (target-share/low-scoring issues), Travis Kelce @ SEA (tough D), Josh Jacobs @ DET (workload post-layoff), Cam Skattebo @ HOU (brutal spot).
items.conflict: Levitan more constructive on Jacobs access.
